transcript.content: Hello, it’s good to meet you. What brings you in today?

I, um... I guess I'm here because things have just been... a bit complicated lately. I work as a financial advisor, and I've just been noticing things. In the arts and finance circles around Cincinnati. It's... well, it seems like certain people are keeping track of who I meet with. My clients. And they send these little signals. Like, the topics they choose for panels, or who they seat next to me at events. Even the invitations I get. I try to tell myself it's just a coincidence, but... I don't know. I just can't seem to shake the feeling.
Do you believe for certain that these people are deliberately sending you signals?
I... I don't know about "for certain." I mean, I try to tell myself it's just a coincidence. But... yes. Yes, I'm pretty convinced they're tracking me. It's just too specific to ignore.
Do you believe these people are definitely tracking you?

I... yeah. Like I just said, I am. I'm convinced they're quietly keeping tabs on which clients I meet with. The invitations, who sits near me... it's all there. Even when I try to tell myself it could just be a coincidence, I... I just can't really let it go.
Have you had a period when you felt unusually energetic and needed much less sleep than usual?
No. I... I don't think so. I sleep fine, usually. I haven't noticed anything like that.
Have you been hearing voices when no one else is around?
No... I don't hear voices. I haven't noticed anything like that.
How long have you been feeling convinced that people are tracking you?
Um... probably about two months. Yeah, around two months since I started noticing the signals... and them keeping track of my meetings.
Lately, have you found yourself losing interest or motivation to do things you usually care about?

I suppose... yeah. I mean, I still get my work done. Just sort of in pieces. I guess I don't really have the same spark lately. I've been letting some client follow-ups sit. 

I haven't really felt like going to jazz nights or playing pickup basketball, either... I just don't really care about missing them. And when friends ask what's going on, I just... I keep it short. Talking just feels like more effort than it should right now.
Have other people told you that your speech has been hard to follow or that you jump from topic to topic?
No... I don't think so. Nobody has mentioned anything like that to me.
Have these experiences of being tracked and sent signals been going on for more than three months?
No, not three months. Like I said before... it's just been about two months. That's when the signals started, and when I noticed they were tracking my meetings.
Have you found yourself showing much less emotion in your face or voice than usual?
I don't know... I haven't really noticed anything like that. People haven't said anything about my face or my voice. I think I sound the same.
Have you had the feeling that other people can read your thoughts?
No... I don't think so. I mean, they send signals, but... I don't think they're reading my mind or anything. Just tracking what I do.
Have there been times lately when your behavior felt very disorganized or unusual to other people?
No... not that I know of. I just go to work and do my job. No one's mentioned anything about me acting weird or disorganized. I just keep to myself mostly.
Outside of feeling tracked and sent signals, have you had any other unusual experiences or beliefs?
No... not really. Just what I already told you. I don't think there's anything else.
Since this started, has your work performance clearly gotten worse?

I mean... I'm still working. I guess my practice is a bit smaller now. I just... I miss some follow-ups sometimes. And I don't really do public panels anymore. It's just harder to keep up with the clients the way I used to. But I'm still doing my job.
Have you had the sense that outside forces are controlling your thoughts or actions?
No... nothing like that. I make my own decisions. It's just... what I already told you about. No one is controlling my thoughts or anything.
Have you felt that your thoughts were being broadcast so that other people could know them?
No. I don't... people can't hear what I'm thinking. That's not happening.
Has your belief that people are tracking you lasted at least three months?
No... not three months. It's been... maybe two? Just about two months since I started noticing them tracking my client meetings. And... sending the signals. So, no, just two months.
Has this belief that people are tracking you been present most days for at least one full month?
Yeah... like I just said, it's been about two months. Since the stuff with the meetings and the signals started. So... yes. Most days.
Did this sense that people were tracking you come on suddenly, over the course of less than two weeks?
I don't really know... I wasn't exactly keeping track of the days when it started. It just sort of... began. I'm not sure how fast it was.
When this started, did the belief that people were tracking you appear suddenly within about two weeks?
I thought I just... I really don't know. Like I said, I wasn't counting the days. It just started.
